Action.description: Declarative action contract. Execution is out of scope for this crate.

oneOf.description: Add `step` to a numeric value, clamped to `[min, max]` if given.
Set a boolean true for `durationMs`, then false.
Acknowledge alarms (one alarm, one group, or all when both are unset).
Download a recipe set to its tags.
Upload current tag values into a recipe set.
Bit `index` of an integer value is set.

delayMs.description: Condition must hold this long before raising (ms).

group.description: Group for filtering and group acknowledgement.

latched.description: Stays active until acknowledged even if the condition clears.

AlarmId.description: Stable identifier (AlarmId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

oneOf.description:
Critical / safety-relevant indication (the HMI is never the safety
function itself).

Arrangement.description: Main-axis arrangement for rows and columns.

Axis.description: Flow axis, used by responsive overrides to switch a row into a column.

oneOf.description: Property -> source (operator input writes the tag).

BindingSource.description: Where a binding takes its value from.

oneOf.description:
The tag supplied to a `tag`-typed parameter of the enclosing
component definition: `{ "tagParameter": "<name>" }`.

A value parameter of the enclosing component definition:
`{ "parameter": "<name>" }` (read-only).

Breakpoint.description: A responsive breakpoint (window width class), in dp.

BreakpointId.description: Stable identifier (BreakpointId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

ComponentDefinition.description: A reusable component (faceplate, symbol, composite widget).

category.description: Library category for the editor palette.

root.description: Root of the definition's layout tree.

ComponentDefinitionId.description: Stable identifier (ComponentDefinitionId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

ComponentKind.description:
Built-in component kinds. The property catalog for each kind lives in
[`crate::catalog`].

oneOf.description: Decorated surface that may host one child layout.

Connection.description: Reference to a PLC or other data source.

credentialRef.description:
Name of a credential held in the runtime's secure store. Projects
never contain secrets.

endpoint.description:
Endpoint (e.g. `opc.tcp://10.0.0.5:4840`). Deployment-specific
endpoints may be overridden at publish time.

ConnectionId.description: Stable identifier (ConnectionId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

CrossAlignment.description: Cross-axis alignment for rows and columns.

oneOf.description: Date and time (ISO-8601 text in JSON values).

DataTypeId.description: Stable identifier (DataTypeId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

DeviceProfile.description:
A target device / resolution profile. Used for editor previews,
responsive rules and publishing; layouts remain responsive.

DeviceProfileId.description: Stable identifier (DeviceProfileId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

DriverKind.description:
Driver family of a connection. The driver itself is not part of this
crate.

oneOf.description: Built-in simulator (development and testing; never touches hardware).

Element.description: The semantic kind of a node.

spacing.description: Gap between children (dp). Ignored by space-* arrangements.

contentAlignment.description: Default alignment of children inside the box.

oneOf.description: Two-dimensional track grid. Children must declare `layout.gridCell`.
Scrollable viewport with exactly one child.

Free-form canvas. Children must declare `layout.position`. Use only
where explicit coordinates are required (P&ID mimics, overlays on
machine pictures); prefer flow containers elsewhere.
A built-in component from the catalog.

parameters.description: Parameter values (validated against the definition parameters).

EventHandler.description: Event handler: an ordered list of actions.

confirm.description: Optional operator confirmation prompt shown before running actions.

EventKind.description: Event raised by a node or screen.

GridCell.description: Placement inside an [`Element::Grid`] parent. Indices are zero-based.

LayoutOverride.description: Overrides applied by a responsive rule. Unset fields are unchanged.

columns.description: Replace grid column tracks (grid elements only).

direction.description: Switch a row/column flow axis (row and column elements only).

gridCell.description: Replace grid placement (children of grids only).

position.description: Replace absolute position (children of absolute parents only).

spacing.description: Row/column spacing (row and column elements only).

LayoutParams.description: Parameters a parent uses to size and place a child.

align.description: Self alignment inside a box parent.

crossAlign.description: Cross-axis self alignment inside a row/column parent.

visibility.description: Static visibility (may be overridden by a `visible` binding).

weight.description: Flex weight along the parent row/column main axis (> 0).

zIndex.description: Paint order among siblings; higher draws above. Ties keep child order.

LocalizedText.description:
Text shown to operators: either a literal or a key into
[`crate::model::Localization::strings`].

NavigationItemId.description: Stable identifier (NavigationItemId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

Node.description: One element of a layout tree.

children.description:
Child nodes, in paint order (later children are drawn above earlier
ones unless `layout.zIndex` says otherwise).

layout.description: How the parent sizes and places this node.

name.description: Optional designer-facing name (layer name). Never used for references.

properties.description:
Typed properties (validated against the component catalog or the
parameters of a component definition).

responsive.description: Responsive overrides, applied in order; later matching rules win.

style.description: Named style applied before local properties.

NodeId.description: Stable identifier (NodeId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

ParameterDefinition.description: Parameter of a reusable component definition.

default.description: Default value. Parameters without a default must be supplied.

Position.description:
Explicit coordinates inside an [`Element::Absolute`] parent (dp, from
the parent's top-start corner).

ProjectId.description: Stable identifier (ProjectId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

ProjectMetadata.description:
Descriptive project metadata. Timestamps are supplied by the caller; the
model never stamps them implicitly, which keeps serialization
reproducible.

defaultDeviceProfile.description: Profile used by the editor canvas when a screen has none.

PropertyBinding.description: Binds a node property (or, on instances, a value parameter) to data.

member.description:
Member path into a structured/array tag, e.g. `status.running` or
`values[3]`.

transform.description: Value conversion between source and property.

PropertyType.description: Type of a property or component parameter.

oneOf.description: Resource identifier, optionally restricted to some kinds.
One of a fixed set of strings.

A tag reference (component definition parameters only). Lets a
reusable faceplate be wired to different tags per instance.

dataType.description: Required data type of the supplied tag, if constrained.

writable.description: Whether the supplied tag must be writable.

RecipeDefinition.description: A recipe definition: a set of tags written together.

RecipeField.description: A recipe field mapped to a writable tag.

RecipeFieldId.description: Stable identifier (RecipeFieldId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

RecipeId.description: Stable identifier (RecipeId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

RecipeSetId.description: Stable identifier (RecipeSetId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

Resource.description:
A project asset. Bytes are stored next to the project document (or in
the bundle) at `path`; the model only references them.

path.description:
Relative, forward-slash path inside the project package
(no `..`, no absolute paths, no URL schemes).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes, for integrity checks on publish.

ResourceId.description: Stable identifier (ResourceId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

oneOf.description: Vector image (SVG subset / Android vector drawable).

ResponsiveCondition.description: Criteria for a responsive rule. At least one criterion is required.

when.description: When the rule applies. All present criteria must match.

ScreenId.description: Stable identifier (ScreenId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

oneOf.description:
Fill the available space (Compose `fillMaxWidth(fraction)`,
Figma "fill container").

fraction.description: Fraction of the available space in `(0, 1]`.

Style.description: A reusable set of property values.

target.description:
Component kind this style is for. Unset = common properties only,
usable on any node.

StyleId.description: Stable identifier (StyleId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

Tag.description:
A tag: a typed process variable. Tags without a connection are internal
(HMI memory) tags.

address.description:
Driver-specific address (required with a connection), e.g.
`ns=3;s="DB_Filler"."Speed"` or `DB10.DBD4`.

connection.description: Source connection; unset for internal tags.

name.description: Display / browse name (may contain `/` for folders).

scanRateMs.description: Requested update interval in milliseconds (0 = driver default).

TagAccess.description: Tag access rights as seen by the HMI.

TagId.description: Stable identifier (TagId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

oneOf.description: A `tag`-typed parameter of the enclosing component definition.

fontFamily.description: Platform font family name (fallback when `font` is unset/unavailable).

Theme.description:
A theme: named design tokens. Components refer to colors with
`{ "token": "<name>" }` so a project can switch between, e.g., day and
night themes without touching screens.

dark.description: Dark theme hint for platform chrome.

metrics.description: Numeric tokens (corner radii, spacing scale, stroke widths) in dp.

ThemeId.description: Stable identifier (ThemeId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

oneOf.description: Share of the remaining space (CSS `fr`, Compose weight).

UnitId.description: Stable identifier (UnitId). Unique across the whole project; never derived from display names.

ValueTransform.description: Value conversion applied by a binding.

oneOf.description: Extract one bit of an integer source as a boolean (read-only).
Map discrete source values to property values (read-only).
Laid out (occupies space) but not drawn and not interactive.
